Better games should still lay ahead, but the Colts may also decide to ease off Taylor's usage down the stretch.

news.analysis: Dell has now caught at least three passes in each of the last three weeks, but his signature big plays have not been there for the most part over the last two games. Still, he has been on the field for just about half of the Texans' offensive snaps over the last three games, and he always has the potential to take one to the house at any point. Dell moves forward as a volatile, big-play receiver for fantasy purposes.

news.contents: Houston Texans wide receiver Tank Dell reeled in three of four targets for 27 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win against the Indianapolis Colts. Dell was heavily utilized on the team's third-quarter touchdown drive, notching receptions of eight, nine, and 10 yards. However, he was otherwise a non-factor on a night that Houston's ground attack led the way.
